ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a forward-thinking and technically capable AI Marketing Operations Manager to build and support K3's AI-powered marketing operations capability within the Marketing Operations function at K3 Advisory Group. You will help drive the AI and automation strategy across the marketing department - spanning prompt engineering, AI tooling governance, automation workflows, and scaled content and data operations. Working closely with the Head of Marketing Operations and wider growth leadership, you will drive operational efficiency, accelerate delivery speed, and identify high-impact AI use cases that create measurable commercial advantage across K3's portfolio.

COMMERCIAL OBJECTIVES

• Profile-driven, AI-powered revenue orchestration (at scale)

• Addressable market coverage, brand awareness & brand engagement

• Multi-channel personalised engagement (brand + CEOs)

• Qualified lead volumes, opportunity CVR, revenue acceleration (at scale) - creating customer intelligence & decisioning

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Management

• Intelligence layer: customer profile schema, ICP models, lead scoring models & intent models

• Automation - journey framework, trigger architecture, AI workflows & decision trees

• Commercial - pipeline acceleration, lead quality improvements, revenue attribution & personalisation performance

Functional Responsibilities

• You will own ICP modelling, persona development, behaviour modelling, lead scoring, intent scoring and opportunity scoring - building the intelligence that powers every downstream campaign.

• You will bring AI personalisation to life through dynamic content, dynamic journeys, dynamic sequencing, offer selection, message optimisation and next-best-action modelling.

• You will build and maintain the customer profile schema, working across audience segmentation, data enrichment, intent signals, behaviour signals and revenue signals.

• You will orchestrate journeys across email, SMS, paid media, website personalisation, sales enablement triggers and customer success triggers.

• You will own the AI personalisation programme end-to-end, from development requirements and roadmap through to the personalisation framework, audience intelligence model, revenue orchestration model and agentic workflow design.

• You will build and continuously optimise the customer profile schema, bringing together firmographic, contact, behavioural, financial and commercial data alongside intent signals.

• You will develop ICP models, buying committee models, sector propensity models, lookalike audiences and win propensity models to sharpen targeting across the business.

• You will design AI-driven orchestration systems where journeys never really end - each interaction shaping and improving what comes next through intelligent decision trees.

• You will build the logic behind AI-powered content decisioning, automating how email content, CTAs, offers, send timing and sequencing are selected based on ICP, behaviour, funnel stage, intent and engagement history.

• You will build intelligence models for lead, opportunity, expansion and churn scoring, giving the business a clear, predictive read on revenue.

• You will define the rules that govern the Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) intelligence layer - audience creation, journey entry/exit, suppression logic, personalisation logic and sales triggers.

• You will build autonomous AI agents and workflows, including content agents, journey agents, ICP agents and sales agents, to scale delivery without scaling headcount.

• You will connect AI activity to commercial outcomes through an attribution and revenue intelligence layer, tracking segment, journey, content and revenue performance.

• You will lead and develop your team, setting clear objectives and driving strong performance.

• You will own governance, compliance and AI quality - building the frameworks for data governance, AI governance, prompt governance, personalisation rules, consent compliance and auditability.

• You will keep your finger on the pulse of the AI landscape, tracking the latest platform trends and advances and using them to continuously improve the sophistication of K3's marketing AI set-up and tooling.

KEY PERFORMANCE MEASURES

• Coverage - personalisation coverage (reach in the millions), pipeline/revenue targets exceeded

• Quality - ICP profile completeness scores, ICP accuracy, CVR rate by segment, pipeline yield

• Quality - compliance, data quality, model accuracy, brand guardianship

• Pipeline - journey conversion, engagement increases, revenue generated

• Channel engagement - open rate, CTR, CVR rate, opportunity creation

• Revenue Ops - scoring accuracy, opportunity CVR, revenue predictability/influence, attribution accuracy

• Efficiency - productivity gains, manual effort reduction, pipeline contribution


WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive salary, commensurate with experience and seniority

• Performance-related bonus linked to individual and business outcomes

• Hybrid and flexible working arrangements

• Structured professional development budget and learning opportunities

• Pension and healthcare options

• Exposure to a broad and diverse portfolio of professional services businesses across K3 Advisory Group

• A fast-paced, commercially driven environment with real scope for career progression


K3 Advisory Group is an equal opportunities employer. This job specification sets out the principal responsibilities for this role and is not an exhaustive list of duties. Responsibilities may evolve over time in line with the needs of the business.

Job Description

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and experienced Data Engineering team at AJ Bell, contributing significantly to the development of our state-of-the-art data platform using cutting-edge technology. As a Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, maintaining, and evolving our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the growing needs of our business. You'll engage in end-to-end development, collaborate closely with key stakeholders and internal customers, and empower the organisation by enabling informed, data-driven decision-making.

What does the job involve?

The key responsibilities of the role are as follows:

  • Collaborating with stakeholders to identify and refine data requirements, ensuring data is accessibility and alignment with business needs.
  • Developing Data Warehousing solutions.
  • Automating extract, load and transform (ELT) pipelines that follow modern CI/CD practices.
  • Data Integration Design – Ensure development is scalable, efficient and future-proof.
  • Data Modelling – Producing clear data models where necessary.
  • Maintaining and continuously enhancing the data platform.
  • Provisioning data from various sources.
  • Create automated tests to ensure quality and integrity of data.
  • Ensure data is compliant with AJ Bell’s Data Governance and Data Classification policies.
  • Maintain data dictionary.
  • Maintain business level data model.
  • Recommending and introducing new technology where needed.

Core:

  • Cloud data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Data transformation technology such as DBT
  • Visual Studio Code
  • Python
  • CI automation systems such as Jenkins
  • A git-based source control system such as BitBucket
  • Data Warehouse/Kimball methodology
  • Data replication technology such as Fivetran HVR.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication skills and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical teams

Other:

  • Good knowledge of IT products and systems
  • Good analytical skills
  • Excellent communication skills verbal and written
  • Able to communicate with people at all levels confidently and effectively
  • Able to prioritise work effectively
  • Customer focussed
  • Flexible approach to work - team player
  • Adaptable to changing environment
  • Self-motivated
  • Embraces continuous learning
  • Previous experience working in an e-commerce and/or financial services business
  • Ability to use Docker and container orchestration tools
  • AWS cloud infrastructure including AWS CDK
  • MS SQL
  • No SQL database such as Mongo
  • AI Tools such as CoPilot, Snowflake Cortex

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work in 2025 and 2026, a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

What we offer

  • 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
  • 6% Pension with matched contributions
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
  • Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
  • Free onsite gym
  • Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
  • Travel and bike loan schemes
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell

  • Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
  • Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
  • Casual dress code
  • Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

For new starters, there’s an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

Inclusion & diversity

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking a Tech Lead - Enterprise Data Platform to work for our client within the finance sector. This is initially a 12 month contract with the potential to extend and will be a hybrid role that will be based in Manchester (Radbroke) 2 days a week.

Our client is supporting the mobilisation of a major Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) programme within a leading UK Banking organisation.

The wider initiative consists of two significant workstreams:

  • Data Hydration onto the new Enterprise Data Platform (EDP)
  • Business Banking consumption of data from the EDP

We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to lead the Business Banking Consumption workstream, ensuring Business Banking capabilities are successfully designed and built to consume data from the new Enterprise Data Platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Business Banking data consumption workstream within the wider EDP transformation programme.
  • Own technical solution design and delivery across a modern data platform environment.
  • Work closely with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements and perform gap analysis.
  • Translate business requirements into technical design and build specifications.
  • Drive alignment with Data Management Controls and enterprise data standards.
  • Manage complex dependencies across multiple workstreams, teams, and stakeholders.
  • Provide leadership across mixed onshore and offshore delivery teams.
  • Present progress, risks, and decisions to Steering Committees, governance forums, and senior stakeholders.
  • Support AI-led development approaches and modern engineering practices.
About You
  • Proven experience delivering Medallion Architecture solutions on modern data platforms.
  • Strong track record leading large-scale data platform migration / modernisation programmes.
  • Experience applying Data Management Control standards into solution design and engineering specifications.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex dependencies across enterprise programmes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and governance experience.

Shape the Future with AI & Data


We are looking for talented AI / Data Engineers to join a growing technology consultancy delivering innovative data, analytics and AI solutions for enterprise clients. This is an exciting opportunity to work with modern cloud, data and AI technologies, helping organisations unlock value from their data and accelerate digital transformation.Whether your background is in Data Engineering, AI Engineering, or both, you'll have the opportunity to design and build scalable solutions that deliver real business impact.


As one of our AI / Data Engineers, you will:

  • Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and data platforms
  • Develop analytics and AI-enabled solutions that support business decision-making
  • Create and implement machine learning and generative AI solutions
  • Integrate data from multiple sources while ensuring data quality and reliability
  • Work closely with analysts, product teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Optimise systems for performance, scalability and efficiency
  • Contribute to testing, monitoring and quality assurance activities
  • Produce clear technical documentation and follow data governance and security best practices


If you possess a combination of some of the following skills, then LETS TALK!

  • Experience as an AI Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Developer or similar
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience building data pipelines and working with both structured and unstructured data
  • Knowledge of AI, machine learning or generative AI technologies
  • Exposure to frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain or similar
  • Experience working with cloud based data platforms and modern data architectures
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience delivering solutions within Agile environments


In return, you will be rewarded with an enviable benefits package in addition to:-

  • Working on cutting-edge AI and data transformation projects
  • Collaborating with highly skilled engineers, analysts and consultants
  • Gaining exposure to enterprise-scale cloud and AI technologies
  • Hybrid working model with Manchester-based collaboration
  • Excellent opportunities for career progression and professional development


Successful applicants must be eligible to obtain UK Security Check (SC) Clearance.

Working closely with the Marketing Director, New Business Team and strategic technology partners, the role will own the planning, execution and optimisation of growth marketing activities across Celerity's key technology pillars, including Cyber Security, AI, Data Resilience, Infrastructure and Software.  The ideal candidate will have previous experience in B2B marketing, ideally within technology, software, MSP or professional services as well as in planning and delivering integrated marketing campaigns.  They will have a strong understanding of demand generation and lead nurturing and be commercially minded with a focus on measurable business outcomes.

As a person you will be curious and proactive, a creative problem solver, a confident communicator and collaborative team player with a passion for continuous development.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns aligned to business growth objectives.
  • Own the delivery of Celerity's new logo marketing engine.
  • Build campaign plans aligned to strategic sales priorities and target industries.
  • Identify new market opportunities and recommend innovative approaches to drive demand.

Campaign Management
  • Plan, execute and optimise multi-channel marketing campaigns.
  • Deliver digital, email, social media, webinar, event and partner marketing campaigns.
  • Ensure all campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and aligned to business objectives.
  • Monitor campaign performance, analyse results and continually optimise activity to improve ROI.

Lead Generation
  • Develop and execute lead generation strategies that deliver measurable pipeline growth.
  • Work closely with the New Business Team to ensure marketing activity supports sales priorities.
  • Manage campaign nurture programmes using HubSpot and other marketing technologies.
  • Track campaign performance, lead quality and conversion through the sales funnel.

Partner Marketing
  • Build strong relationships with strategic technology partners including IBM, Veeam, Lenovo and others.
  • Develop joint marketing campaigns and maximise partner marketing investment (MDF).
  • Coordinate co-branded campaigns, events and content.

Events & Executive Engagement
  • Plan and deliver executive roundtables, webinars, conferences, exhibitions
  • Manage agencies and suppliers where required.
  • Ensure all events deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

Content & Communications
  • Collaborate with the wider marketing team to develop compelling campaign messaging and content.
  • Produce campaign briefs, customer stories, landing pages, email campaigns and promotional copy.
  • Ensure all communications reflect the Celerity brand and value proposition.

Performance & Reporting
  • Produce regular reports on campaign performance and marketing contribution to pipeline.
  • Analyse marketing metrics to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Maintain accurate campaign records within HubSpot and CRM systems.
  • Present campaign performance and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Collaboration
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Technical Practices and Business Unit leaders.
  • Support wider marketing initiatives where required.
  • Contribute to a high-performing, collaborative marketing team.

Job Description

As part of our continued growth and investment in our data and analytics capabilities, we’re recruiting for an experienced Senior BI Developer to join our dynamic direct-to-consumer (D2C) business. This is a key opportunity to play a central role in shaping how data is leveraged to drive insight, inform decisions, and support ongoing business success. 

As the Senior BI Developer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining the data assets that underpin our reporting, analytics, and customer marketing capabilities. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to define requirements, develop best-in-class data products, and produce engaging and accurate reporting used by our teams and senior managers to track performance and make strategic decisions.

You’ll also form a key part of our wider data community, ensuring that our organisational data supports our ambitious growth targets. And most importantly you will contribute to our company data strategy by supporting colleagues to become even more data literate and ensuring they have reliable and relevant data and reporting at their fingertips.

What you’ll be doing

  • Working closely with internal stakeholders to define and deliver the data products and reports which meet their needs
  • Collaborating with data engineers and integration specialists within the team and across the wider business to deliver data pipelines, ETL processes and data models that meet requirements
  • Developing and maintaining a suite of engaging Power BI dashboards including enterprise level semantic models along with user and data permissions management
  • Owning and continuously improving the data models including data and KPI definitions ensuring consistency of use
  • Supporting analysts and researchers in the team with data-driven initiatives, ensuring they have the data at hand to complete projects
  • Developing, maintaining, and adhering to robust data and delivery processes including testing, monitoring, documentation, and issue resolution.
  • Contributing to the overall data literacy of the business by ensuring data and dashboards are understood and adopted
  • Supporting our wider company data strategy by contributing and adhering to our data development frameworks, and engaging with Data Governance to resolve quality and integrity issues

What we’re looking for

We're looking for someone with a broad range of competence, knowledge and skills which would help you succeed in this role, but it is not critical to meet every single criteria listed below. We encourage a wide range of applicants.

  • Proven mid to senior level experience in data engineering, data architecture design and delivery, and BI within a data-intensive environment
  • Working with data from multiple systems and structures and at different velocities including near real time
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture (Snowflake is preferred), SQL development, security, and process optimisation
  • Advanced SQL development including query development and optimisation, stored procedures, and performance tuning
  • Expert knowledge of end-to-end enterprise BI using Power BI including semantic modelling, DAX, Power Query, data visualisation best practice, report development, and performance optimisation
  • Advanced data modelling including dimensional modelling, star schema design, database layers, and data mart development
  • Knowledge of BI solution delivery methodologies including requirements and discovery, Agile delivery, testing, deployment, and post-production support
  • Strong understanding of data governance and security frameworks including data quality, metadata management, lineage, user and permission management, compliance, and access controls
  • Excellent documentation skills with the ability to create and maintain solution designs, data dictionaries, business glossaries and technical standards
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and business partnering skills with the ability to translate business requirements into data solutions
  • Experience of marketing orchestration platforms (e.g. Bloomreach) or reverse ETL tools (e.g. HighTouch) is desirable
  • Knowledge of marketing and digital data (e.g. Google Analytics, BiqQuery) would be advantageous
  • Change management using JIRA and Confluence would be an advantage
  • Experience using and implementing AI agents for code creation and process efficiency would be advantageous

Data Engineering Manager (hands on) - Manchester

I’m working with a hypergrowth business in Manchester who are looking for a Data Engineering Manager. They have new PE investment behind them and a major transformation project is underway.

This is a hands-on leadership role sitting at the centre of a significant data platform transformation. You will be running the data engineering squad, responsible for delivering the data infrastructure, pipelines, and reporting capabilities the wider business depends on.

They are moving away from traditional batch processing toward a real-time, event-driven architecture and you will be leading that technical journey while keeping everything running reliably in the meantime. It is not a steady-state role there is a real mandate for change, proper investment to back it up, and a new Data Director coming in who wants to build something impressive.

What’s in it for you?

  • £88,000
  • Hybrid working, 3 days per week in Manchester City Centre
  • 27 days holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off,
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Income protection for up to 5 years, life assurance at 3x salary, health cash plan, virtual GP and therapy access
  • Gym discounts, cycle to work, free food and a Friday bar + much more.
  • A genuine leadership seat at the table during a period of real transformation
  • The chance to modernise a data platform from the ground up, event streaming, cloud-native, AI-ready
  • Newly centralised data function with a clear path upward as it grows

Must have:

  • Cloud data engineering on AWS – this is non-negotiable
  • People management and team leadership experience
  • Strong SQL and T-SQL
  • ETL/ELT pipelines, SSIS, Matillion or similar
  • Data visualisation
  • Infrastructure as Code awareness, Terraform or similar
  • Stakeholder management

 Nice to have:

  • Real-time and event-driven data platform experience
  • Lakehouse or cloud-native data platform architecture experience
  • Data lakes, object storage, and large-scale analytical processing
  • ML or advanced analytics exposure
  • AWS security, networking and access control
  • GDPR and data governance awareness

Day to Day:

  • Leading and developing your data engineering squad performance conversations, career development, day-to-day support
  • Getting hands-on across pipelines, cloud infrastructure, transformation layers, and reporting
  • Driving the migration toward real-time, event-driven data processing
  • Keeping existing SQL Server environments stable and performant while the modern platform is built out
  • Working closely with stakeholders across the business to understand requirements and deliver solutions
  • Embedding good engineering practices CI/CD, IaC, Agile where they are not already in place
  • Mentoring colleagues and helping to grow capability across the team

Why it’s a good time to join them?

The data, analytics and insights functions previously operated separately are being brought together for the first time under a single Data Director. That means you would be joining at the moment the foundation is being laid, not after the decisions have already been made.

There is a signed-off transformation programme, a technical roadmap that includes real-time streaming, AI-readiness and a move toward a modern cloud platform, and senior leadership that genuinely values data.

Forward Role is operating as an employment agency.

The Engineering Lead is a hands-on technical leader responsible for guiding a cross-functional engineering squad in the delivery of high-quality, secure, reliable, and scalable software. Combining the responsibilities of a senior engineer with those of a team enabler, the role promotes strong engineering practices, effective delivery, and close collaboration with Product, Architecture, and Site Reliability Engineering teams.

The Engineering Lead also supports the Engineering Manager in scaling engineering excellence across multiple squads, while fostering a culture of aligned autonomy, continuous improvement, technical craftsmanship, and innovation. The role champions agentic development practices, promoting the effective use of autonomous and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and enhance software quality.

The organisation is currently undertaking a significant redevelopment programme, replacing an underperforming PHP application with a highly optimised modular platform. A key responsibility of this role will be to lead the technical direction of this transformation, including driving architectural and technology decisions to ensure the new solution is performant, maintainable, resilient, and fit for long-term growth.

As we scale towards multiple autonomous squads, the Engineering Team Leader plays a crucial role in shaping the engineering culture at the team level, ensuring technical excellence, secure delivery, and strong collaboration across the organisation. You will set the pace, uphold engineering standards, and enable your team to deliver reliable and modern cloud-native services with confidence and autonomy.

This is a full time, permanent position working on a hybrid basis with 3 days per week in Manchester.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Delivery:

  • Lead the squad in delivering high-quality software, ensuring adherence to secure-by-design and engineering best practices.
  • Own the squad’s day-to-day technical direction, ensuring alignment with architectural patterns and technical strategy.
  • Break down complex requirements into actionable engineering tasks and support backlog refinement.
  • Drive predictable delivery through strong Agile practices, partnering with the Engineering Manager and Scrum Master.
  • Conduct code reviews, lead design discussions, and champion technical excellence within the team.

Engineering Execution & Hands-On Contribution:

  • Remain an active contributor to the codebase, setting the standard for code quality, testing, and documentation.
  • Support troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis for squad-owned services.
  • Promote best practices in cloud-native development, CI/CD, observability, and reliability engineering.
  • Pair-program with engineers, provide technical mentoring, and encourage knowledge sharing.

Squad Leadership & Team Development:

  • Foster a healthy team culture built on psychological safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support squad members with coaching, onboarding, and day-to-day guidance, escalating people issues to the Engineering Manager when needed.
  • Help identify skills gaps and support growth plans for engineers.
  • Encourage learning, experimentation, and adoption of modern engineering practices.

Process Ownership & Continuous Improvement:

  • Champion efficient engineering processes and development workflows within the squad.
  • Ensure adherence to SDLC, coding standards, secure coding practices, and quality gates.
  • Promote and facilitate retrospectives, driving actionable improvements.
  • Help shape squad ceremonies and practices in partnership with Scrum Master and Product Owner.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Partner with the Solutions Architect to ensure architectural consistency and alignment with strategic design patterns.
  • Work closely with the Lead SRE to embed reliability, observability, and CI/CD into day-to-day engineering workflows.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners to refine requirements, manage scope, and support prioritisation.
  • Communicate squad progress, risks, and technical challenges to the Engineering Manager and stakeholders.

Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience as a senior engineer or tech lead within modern, cloud-native engineering environments.
  • Agentic Development process and practice experience.
  • Strong technical skills in modern development frameworks (e.g. Node.js, PHP, C#, .NET, React) and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead engineering practices such as code reviews, design sessions, testing, and CI/CD.
  • Solid understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps principles, and secure software development practices. (Azure DevOps)
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to guide, mentor, and collaborate effectively across disciplines.
  • Exposure to microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed system design.

Location: Edinburgh or Manchester (Hybrid - 1 day onsite per week, Wednesdays)
Type: Contract

Overview

We're looking for a highly data-focused Data Analyst to support the development of data products within a modern AWS-based architecture. This role is centred on deep data analysis and discovery (70%), alongside logical data modelling (30%), helping shape how raw data is standardised, structured, and consumed.

You'll work closely with engineering teams, translating business needs into technical user stories and supporting the evolution of scalable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Discovery (70%)

  • Conduct detailed data discovery across multiple datasets, identifying structure, quality, and relationships
  • Investigate and interrogate data to uncover insights and anomalies
  • Work hands-on with SQL to query and analyse large datasets
  • Support data grouping, profiling, and exploration activities
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define data requirements and translate these into actionable outputs
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of data products

Data Modelling (30%)

  • Develop and maintain logical data models (LDM)
  • Map and align data structures to Federated Data Models (FDM)
  • Support data standardisation processes, particularly from raw data sources
  • Work closely with architecture and engineering teams on data product architecture
  • Ensure consistency and best practice across data modelling and design

Technical Environment & Experience

  • Strong SQL skills (essential)
  • Experience working with AWS (including S3 buckets)
  • Exposure to data product architecture
  • Understanding of raw data ingestion and standardisation
  • Experience collaborating with data engineering / extract engineering teams
  • Ability to write and refine technical user stories


Skills & Profile

  • Highly analytical with a strong focus on data investigation and discovery
  • Comfortable working in data-heavy, complex environments
  • Strong understanding of logical data modelling principles
  • Ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical delivery
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and confident working with ambiguous datasets


Additional Information

  • Hybrid working: 1 day per week onsite (Wednesday) in either Edinburgh or Manchester
  • Flexible engagement options available
  • Fast-paced, delivery-focused environment

Role Profile: Data Quality Analyst

Role Purpose
Responsible for ensuring data across the organisation is accurate, complete, consistent and reliable - tracking down anomalies, understanding how data flows through the business, and improving quality at source and downstream. Acts as the link between business needs and technical delivery.

Core Responsibilities

  • Profile datasets against quality dimensions (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity) and track issues over time via dashboards
  • Define and refine data quality rules with stakeholders; build automated checks into ETL/warehouse/reporting environments
  • Investigate root causes of anomalies and work with system owners on fixes and longer-term prevention
  • Support data governance: dictionaries, quality frameworks, stewardship and consistent data definitions
  • Partner with data engineers, analysts and SMEs to embed quality controls and automate validation/cleansing

Skills & Experience

  • Strong SQL for analysis, validation and investigation
  • Track record delivering data quality improvement plans (regulated sector a plus)
  • Familiarity with governance tools (e.g. Azure Purview)
  • Experience setting data quality metrics, thresholds and dashboards
  • Understanding of ETL processes and translating business rules into technical validation logic
  • Clear communicator, able to explain complex findings simply

Attributes

  • Curious and methodical, but delivery-focused
  • Confident challenging assumptions
  • Sees data quality as core to good system design, not just inspection

We're looking for a commercially minded Senior Finance Analyst to join our Finance team on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This is an exciting opportunity for a part-qualified or newly-qualified accountant who enjoys combining strong financial reporting with insightful analysis and business partnering.

Working closely with the Finance Business Partner and CFO, you will play a key role in delivering accurate month-end reporting, supporting budgeting and forecasting activities, and providing the financial insight that helps drive business performance.   • Supporting the production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts and KPI reporting.
  • Owning key aspects of the month-end close process, ensuring reporting deadlines are met.
  • Preparing insightful variance analysis and commentary to explain business performance.
  • Maintaining robust balance sheet reconciliations and financial controls.

Turning Data into Insight:

  • Analysing financial and operational data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
  • Producing meaningful analysis that supports decision-making across the business.
  • Delivering reporting and ad hoc analysis for senior finance and business stakeholders.

  • Assisting with budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning activities.

Strengthening Revenue Reporting and Financial Control:

  • Supporting the integrity and accuracy of revenue reporting.
  • Investigating and resolving financial discrepancies in partnership with operational and commercial teams.
  • Helping ensure strong governance and financial controls are maintained across reporting activities.

Driving Continuous Improvement:

  • Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting and controls.
  • Supporting finance transformation and reporting improvement initiatives.
  • Helping build more efficient, scalable and data-driven ways of working across the finance team.

Skills & Experience

  • Part-qualified or newly-qualified ACA, ACCA or CIMA accountant.
  • Experience within a finance, management accounting or financial analysis role.
  • Strong experience supporting month-end reporting and financial analysis.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large volumes of data.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate financial information into meaningful business insight.
  • Experience using ERP, reporting or planning systems. (Experience of NetSuite or Anaplan would be preferable)
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver to tight deadlines.
  • Experience supporting budgeting and forecasting processes.
  • Exposure to finance transformation, process improvement or reporting automation initiatives.
